name: Vantorix – Toolkit for Elementor
author: Vantorix

sections.description:
Vantorix – Toolkit for Elementor is a complete all-in-one Elementor toolkit that empowers you to build professional websites with ease — without touching a single line of code.

Whether you need custom headers, footers, popups, archive layouts, or beautiful widgets, Vantorix – Toolkit for Elementor has you covered.

Key Features

  • Header & Footer Builder — Design custom headers and footers with full Elementor control.
  • Popup Builder — Create stunning popups with advanced display conditions.
  • 404 Page Builder — Design beautiful custom 404 error pages, with redirects and hit logging.
  • Screen Loader — Add elegant loading screens to your website.
  • 30+ Elementor Widgets — Including Nav Menu, Post Block, Gallery, Testimonial, Marquee, Progress, Toggle, and many more.
  • Import / Export — Easily backup and restore your settings.
  • Lightweight & Fast — Modular architecture loads only what you enable.

Every feature listed above is included. Nothing in this plugin is locked or limited.

Also available

The theme building modules — Archive Builder, Single Post Builder, Search Builder, Dynamic Tags and the Template Library — are distributed separately as the Vantorix Pro add-on, which is not hosted on WordPress.org. They are not part of this plugin and none of their code is included here.

Included Widgets

  • Advanced Heading
  • Advanced Button
  • Advanced Image
  • Advanced Icon Box
  • Nav Menu
  • Back to Top
  • Accordion
  • Toggle
  • Testimonial
  • Marquee
  • Brand / Logo Carousel
  • Post Block
  • Post List
  • Post Info
  • Post Share
  • Post Terms
  • Post Comments
  • Post Content
  • Post Excerpt
  • Post Title
  • Search
  • Search Results
  • Gallery
  • Categories
  • Tag Cloud
  • Progress Bar
  • Feature Cards
  • Social Icons
  • Advanced Breadcrumb
  • Advanced Post Title
  • Error Code (404)

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • Elementor (Free) 3.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.2 or higher

Third-Party Services

This plugin provides social sharing widgets (such as the Post Share and Post Block widgets) that generate standard HTML links to third-party platforms. When a user clicks these links, they are redirected to the respective third-party service to complete the sharing action.

No automatic data transmission occurs in the background, and no tracking scripts or iframes from these services are loaded on your site. Only the post title and URL are passed via standard URL parameters to the sharing endpoint when the user explicitly clicks the button.

These external services are governed by their own Privacy Policies and Terms of Service:
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/policy.php
* Twitter / X: https://twitter.com/en/privacy
* WhatsApp: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

    Source: https://github.com/aamirafridi/jQuery.Marquee
    License: MIT

  • Isotope PACKAGED (assets/js/isotope.pkgd.min.js) – Version 3.0.6
    Source: https://github.com/metafizzy/isotope
    License: GPLv3 (see https://isotope.metafizzy.co/license.html)

  • QRious (assets/js/vendor/qrious.min.js) – Version 4.0.2
    Source: https://github.com/neocotic/qrious
    License: GPLv3

Plugin JavaScript (assets/frontend/js/, assets/admin/js/):

Build tool: None.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire vantorix-toolkit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, OR install via Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Go to Vantorix > Dashboard to enable/disable modules and widgets.
  5. Start using the new widgets inside your Elementor editor under the Vantorix widget category.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Vantorix – Toolkit for Elementor is designed as an addon for the Elementor Page Builder. Both the free Elementor plugin and Elementor Pro are supported.

Is this plugin compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes, Vantorix – Toolkit for Elementor works with any WordPress theme. For best results, use a theme that is compatible with Elementor.

Can I use this to build custom headers and footers?

Absolutely. The Header & Footer Builder module lets you design fully custom header and footer layouts using Elementor and assign them to any page or condition.

Can I disable widgets I don’t need?

Yes. Go to Vantorix > Widgets to enable or disable individual widgets. Disabled widgets do not load any assets, keeping your site fast.

Can I disable modules I don’t need?

Yes. Go to Vantorix > Modules to enable or disable individual modules like Popup Builder, Header Builder, etc.

Do I have to buy anything?

No. Every module and widget in this plugin is free and fully functional. The separate Vantorix Pro add-on adds extra theme building modules on top, but nothing here depends on it.

Where did the Archive and Single Post builders go?

They moved to the separate Vantorix Pro add-on in version 1.1.0. They were never usable in this plugin — they shipped switched off — so nothing you were using has been taken away.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Fixed 404 Builder settings never saving. register_setting() applies its sanitize callback to every write of the settings option, and that callback was discarding any key it did not recognise — which included every 404 Builder setting. Settings from other screens are now left alone.
  • Fixed the settings sanitizer stripping HTML from the 404 Builder’s custom header and footer code fields.

1.1.2

  • Fixed 404 Builder settings reporting success but not taking effect. Saving any one tab was clearing the settings on the other tabs, because only the visible tab’s fields exist in the form.
  • Fixed the main Settings screen wiping settings that belong to other screens, including everything in the 404 Builder.
  • Fixed checkboxes on the Settings screen never appearing ticked.
  • Clearing a checkbox or switch on the Settings screen now saves; previously the old value stayed.

1.1.1

  • Fixed the Header & Footer Builder buttons doing nothing. The admin script declared a dependency on a select2 handle that is never registered, so WordPress silently refused to load it.
  • The same missing dependency also stopped the display conditions panel from loading.
  • Premium modules are now off until you switch them on, instead of all turning on at once when the Pro add-on is licensed.
  • Premium modules can be switched off again after being enabled.
  • Moved the module card ribbon back inside the card.

1.1.0

  • The theme building modules (Archive Builder, Single Post Builder, Search Builder, Dynamic Tags and Template Library) have moved to the separate Vantorix Pro add-on. They are no longer part of this plugin.
  • Removed the placeholder “coming soon” module locks.
  • Added vantorix_modules_loaded and vantorix_register_dynamic_tags hooks so add-ons can register their own modules.
  • Fixed the folder name in the manual installation steps.
  • Corrected the minimum WordPress version stated in the description.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • 30+ Elementor widgets included.
  • Header & Footer Builder module.
  • Popup Builder module.
  • Archive Builder module.
  • Single Post Builder module.
  • 404 Page Builder module.
  • Search Builder module.
  • Screen Loader module.
  • Template Library module.
  • 40+ Dynamic Tags.
  • Custom Post Types (Services, Projects, Teams, Galleries).
  • Import / Export settings.
